text: Core courses Sketch Model, Color Displaying, Basic Traditional Chinese Painting, Basic Oil Painting, Basic Water Colour, Human Body Sketch, Outline of Arts, Traditional Chinese Landscape Painting, Traditional Chinese Fine Birds and Flowers Painting, Traditional Chinese Fine Figure Painting, Technique of Oil Painting Materials, Still Life of Oil Painting, Landscapes of Oil Painting, Technique of Water Colour Material, Still Life of Water Colour, Head Portrait of Water Colour, etc. Objective This objective is to train students to be the high-qualified personnel of fine arts education when they graduate, who grasp the basic theory, knowledge and technical ability of fine arts education; at the same time they have initiative spirit, practice ability and certain capacity of fine arts teaching and research. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 190 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted.
